H9 WHAT THIS CANNOT SHOW
One drug, one cell line. A fix that helps the A549 dexamethasone plateau is not
thereby a general improvement to cell modelling.
FIX 4 is tested for REPRODUCIBILITY on Perturb-seq, where single cells exist, then
carried into the A549 stack as a feature. A549 is bulk with four replicates and has
no single-cell layer, so the stochastic fix cannot be tested directly against this
target -- only its downstream usefulness can.
Local contact density is Hi-C-derived from other cell types, so FIX 1's enrichment
proxy is not measured in A549 and a failure could be the proxy, not the principle.
DNase accessibility stands in for ATP-driven remodeller activity in FIX 2. It is a
consequence of remodelling rather than a measurement of it.
